Corollary
[Area comparison for embedded curve-shrinking flow] Under the preceding hypotheses on $[t^-,t^+]$, let $\psi '=-2\pi -\frac12R_{\min }\psi $ with $\psi (t^-)=A(t^-)$. Then $A(t^+)\le \psi (t^+)$.
Proof

\sketch Apply Lemma lem:forward-difference-quotient to Lemma 4.

□
